PATCH /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-.description: Replaces a saved domain query's tag and patterns. `tag` and `string_matches` are required, and the patterns you send replace the existing ones, so include every pattern you want to keep. Changing the patterns starts a new set of matches for the query: matches listed before the change are no longer returned, and only newly observed domains that match the new patterns are listed. Sending the same patterns in any order (for example, to change only `tag`) keeps the existing matches. If the new patterns are identical to a set already used in this account, such as the query's earlier patterns, matches already found for that set are listed as well. Omitting both `scan_matches` and its alias `scan` resets scanning to `false`. If both are supplied, `scan_matches` takes precedence. `search_lookback`, `min_time`, and `max_time` are ignored on update, so changing patterns does not search previously observed domains. If the query does not exist in this account, the request fails with error code 404.

parameters.name: query_id
parameters.description: ID of the domain query.

schema.description: ID of the domain query.

max_time.description: Not currently used. Accepted and ignored.

min_time.description: Not currently used. Accepted and ignored.

scan.description: Alias for `scan_matches`. If both are set, `scan_matches` takes precedence.

search_lookback.description: On create, also search domains observed in the last 7 days for matches. Defaults to `true`. Ignored on update.

string_matches.description: Patterns to match against domain names, 1 to 100 per query. Each `pattern` is a brand name or keyword of up to 200 characters. Matching also catches close variants such as typos and look-alike characters; patterns are not regular expressions. On update, this list replaces the query's existing patterns.

tag.description: Name of the query. Must be unique among the account's domain queries.

query_id.description: ID of the created or updated domain query.

POST /accounts/{account_id}/cloudforce-o.description: Dismisses or undismisses up to 100 domain matches in one request and returns a result for each item. Send `matches` as (`query_id`, `domain_id`) pairs to change each match for one query. The legacy `match_ids` format is still accepted, but it changes each match for every query that shares it; prefer `matches`.

action.description: `dismiss` to dismiss the matches, or `undismiss` to restore them.

match_ids.description: Legacy format; prefer `matches`. Match IDs to update. Each ID changes the match for every query that shares it, not just one query. 1 to 100 items; duplicate IDs are rejected.

matches.description: Matches to update, as (`query_id`, `domain_id`) pairs. Each pair changes the match for that query only. 1 to 100 items; duplicate pairs are rejected. Send only one format. If both are supplied, `match_ids` takes precedence and `matches` is ignored.

domain_id.description: ID of the matched domain, as returned in `domain_id` by List domain matches with `include_domain_id=true`.

error.description: Why this item failed, such as `Query not found` or `Match not found`.

success.description: Whether this item succeeded. Items already in the requested state succeed.
